title: Uniqueness of compatible restriction of a local cocone
statement: Let R, p, A = R_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], K, χ : κ_R(p) → K, q and ψ : κ_A(q) → K [def-weil-residue-field] satisfy the parent hypotheses: the evaluation through ψ is the specified A-algebra map into K, and its restriction to R is evaluation through χ. Use pointed étale triples [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples] and the compatible-leg relation [new-def-sbc-etale-triples-prime-localization-cocone-relation]. For every ring V and local cocone θ, any two global cocones η and η' satisfying the compatible-leg relation are equal.

source.place: Tag 04GW; Section 10.9, Proposition 10.9.3; Tag 00U2 (3). The cocone reduction is an agent-written consequence, not a verbatim theorem.

proof.text: For each global triple s, obtain a local triple t and a map beta satisfying the structural-map and pointing equations from the compatible-map existence lemma.

Apply both compatible-leg relations to the same s, t, beta and equations. Both eta.app s and eta'.app s equal beta followed by theta.app t. Equality at every s gives equality of natural transformations by NatTrans.ext.

proof_origin.place: Original localization construction split off; cocone relations and natural-transformation extensionality complete the argument.
